design_description: A dark, understated design built around a large tone-on-tone wolf graphic. The jersey uses an almost-black midnight navy base, with the graphic rendered in a slightly lighter deep blue so it emerges subtly rather than behaving like a conventional high-contrast print. The main feature is the oversized abstract wolf silhouette. It begins around the lower torso and sweeps diagonally upward through sharp, angular shapes suggesting the fur, head and profile of the animal. The artwork continues onto the back, creating one cohesive visual identity across the garment while remaining deliberately low-contrast. Small brighter-blue accents add structure: parallel shoulder stripes, blue collar edging and fine sleeve-cuff detailing. These provide definition without competing with the wolf motif. The front stays relatively clean in the upper chest, allowing the crest and other elements to remain clearly readable. On the back, the same subtle wolf artwork occupies the lower portion while the upper area remains dark and uncluttered for the large white number with navy and blue outlining. A single white star beneath the rear collar provides a small contrasting detail. Overall, it is a monochromatic navy-on-navy concept with restrained blue highlights. The strength of the design comes from using the team symbol itself as the pattern: the wolf is enormous and unmistakable when noticed, but because it is tone-on-tone, it feels integrated into the fabric rather than printed on top of it.
